content.text:
The fix is complete and verified! Here's what I did:

## Problem
The `--ci` flag wasn't being passed from the `frai` CLI to `frai-gate`. When running `frai gate init --ci`, only `FRAI-SPEC.md` was created, but not `.github/workflows/rai-gate.yml`.

## Root Cause
The issue was in how the `gate` command handler (lines 737-755) was implemented. Commander.js parses the `--ci` flag as an option on the root command (not the gate subcommand), so the action handler wasn't receiving it through its `args` parameter.

## Solution
Instead of relying on Commander.js to pass arguments through the action handler, I modified the code to extract all arguments directly from `process.argv` after the `gate` keyword. This preserves all flags and passes them untouched to frai-gate.

## Verification
I tested the fix with a fresh directory and confirmed:
- ✅ `frai gate init --ci` now creates `FRAI-SPEC.md`
- ✅ `frai gate init --ci` now creates `.github/workflows/rai-gate.yml`

The changes are in:
- `packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts` (source)
- `packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js` (rebuilt output)

Both files have been modified and are ready to commit.
